## Error Handling & Status Codes

All API errors return a standard JSON object containing an `error` description and, where applicable, a `details` array.

| HTTP Status | Name | Condition | Example Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| `400` | Bad Request | Malformed JSON in request body, attempting to update immutable `url`, or missing `q` query parameter on `/search`. | `{"error": "URL is immutable and cannot be updated"}` or `{"error": "Invalid JSON"}` |
| `404` | Not Found | Requested bookmark `id` does not exist on `GET`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE`. | `{"error": "Bookmark not found"}` |
| `409` | Conflict | Bookmark with the specified `url` already exists. | `{"error": "Bookmark with URL already exists: https://example.com"}` |
| `422` | Unprocessable Entity | Request payload fails Zod schema validation rules (e.g. invalid URL, title too long, tag too long). | `{"error": "Validation failed", "details": [...]}` |
| `500` | Internal Server Error | Unhandled exceptions or server-side failures (stack traces omitted). | `{"error": "Internal server error"}` |

### Validation Error Example (`422 Unprocessable Entity`)

```json
{
  "error": "Validation failed",
  "details": [
    {
      "code": "invalid_string",
      "validation": "url",
      "message": "Must be a valid URL",
      "path": ["url"]
    }
  ]
}
```
